descFull: Free, open-source playlist sync for Android, Windows, macOS, Linux and Docker. Keeps playlists identical across Spotify, YouTube Music, Apple Music, Amazon Music, TIDAL, Deezer, LiveOne, Anghami, Navidrome, Jellyfin and Plex. Scheduled syncs, easy review of tracks not found. No Trackhop account or server: everything stays on your devices.
